lines.text: Nigeria's flag was designed by a student. And the judges cut part of his design.
In 1959, Taiwo Akinkunmi, a young Nigerian studying in Britain, saw a newspaper advert: design the flag of a soon to be independent Nigeria.
His design beat nearly three thousand entries.
Green for the land and farming. White for peace and unity.
But his original had a red sun with rays in the middle. The judges removed it.
He won one hundred pounds. And on October first, 1960, his flag went up.
Next time you see the green white green, remember him. Follow for more Naija history!
